prompt:
ONE continuous TEN-SECOND photorealistic vertical 9:16 video. REFERENCE 1 exact opening; REFERENCE 2 original product; REFERENCE 3 canonical adult identity. Keep exact opening composition. Exactly ONE palm-sized pastel lavender power bank matching product reference: thick rounded rectangular rigid smooth shell, glossy BLACK rounded rectangular level window at one end of the broad front face, original white level markings, one short matching lavender loop and original seam. Preserve shell/window/loop proportions and relative positions. Never add cables, extra loops, new ports, brand names or accessories. The loop is a strap, not a charging cable. Keep original front facing the camera; no rear or hidden-edge reconstruction.
The exact fictional adult woman from canonical reference: low dark ponytail, oval face, cream long-sleeve blouse.
Bright pale-oak electronics review counter, warm-white wall and soft blurred neutral accessory shelves, no signs or readable packaging. Fixed diffuse studio key and fill at 5200K, no visible window, no moving sunlight, same bright lighting in all scenes.
Fixed tripod, no orbit, zoom or camera tilt. Maintain original window and loop position relative to shell in frame; no in-plane rotation, flip, upright turn or grip change. Keep black window BLACK and its markings stable. Real other-hand contact, no finger merging or extra fingers. No fake charging demo. Lips closed; no speaking, music or generated narration. No cuts or fade.
ACTION TIMELINE: 0–1.0s: supporting palm raises the product 2 cm with clearly visible immediate movement. 1.0–1.5s: natural short settling pause with real hand micro-motion. 1.5–3.0s: tilt the entire rigid product only 5 degrees in depth, front and black window always visible, same supporting grip and wrist orientation. 3.0–5.7s: the OTHER hand's index and middle fingertips actually touch the BLANK lavender shell and stroke a short 2 cm path once, with plausible contact shadow. Do not hover, point beside it, touch or cover the window. 5.7–7.5s: fingertips lift and product returns those same 5 degrees. 7.5–10s: present securely with gentle natural movement, full product and loop in frame.
No added text anywhere: no captions, subtitles, titles, cards, watermark, readable background signs or invented product lettering. Preserve only intrinsic product markings. No collage or graphic layout.
EXPOSURE CONTINUITY: identical bright diffuse studio illumination from the first to the last frame, locked camera exposure and white balance, no auto exposure ramp, no fade, vignette, dramatic grading, dimming or moving shadows. Preserve the opening photograph's product/skin brightness and colors. Camera motion must not cause the face, clothes or product to gradually darken.
